rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when something is immediately obvious or self-evident.

example.english: From the way they look, it is axiomatic that they want to shirk responsibility.
example.traditional: 睇佢個樣，好明顯係想推卸責任。
example.jyutping: tai2 keoi5 go3 joeng2 hou2 ming4 hin2 hai6 soeng2 teoi1 se3 zaak3 jam6

rows.note: Use this when the point is accepted as naturally or obviously true rather than merely easy to see.

example.english: When parents grow old, it is axiomatic that their children should look after them.
example.traditional: 父母老咗，仔女照顧佢哋係理所當然嘅。
example.jyutping: fu6 mou5 lou5 zo2 zai2 neoi2 ziu3 gu3 keoi5 dei6 hai6 lei5 so2 dong1 jin4 ge3

rows.note: Use this in formal contexts when emphasizing that something is beyond reasonable doubt.

example.english: On the available evidence, this conclusion is axiomatic.
example.traditional: 根據現有證據，呢個結論係毋庸置疑嘅。
example.jyutping: gan1 geoi3 jin6 jau5 zing3 geoi3 ni1 go3 git3 leon6 hai6 mou4 jung4 zi3 ji4 ge3
